office: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division

feeds.what: every contest of the election in one document, statewide/district totals only (202 offices: US House, 6 statewide, 16 State Senator districts, 109 State Representative districts, 70 county offices), the 'RSS' the site advertises
feeds.notes: Stable URL per election (no timestamp in it): …/elections/rss/<electionGuid>/election-summary.xml. 126,561 bytes gzipped. Cache-Control: public, max-age=60; Last-Modified matched the JSON publish. <rss><channel><ElectionSummary><ElectionDate>11/03/2026</ElectionDate><ElectionType>G</ElectionType><Office><OfficeName>…</OfficeName><OfficeDistrict/>…<VoteFor>1</VoteFor><Candidate><CandidateId/><Name/><PartyName/><Votes/><CandidateType>Registered|Write-in</CandidateType><Winner>True|False</Winner></Candidate>…<OtherWriteInVotes/><BlankVotes/><Overvotes/></Office>. It is big because every individual write-in name is a <Candidate> (8,281 write-in entries vs 422 registered): filter on CandidateType. It has no last-updated stamp and no towns-reporting count; get those from the pointer JSON.

feeds.what: pointer document for the election: names the current timestamped result files, last-updated time, towns reporting, town and district lookup tables
feeds.notes: …/elections/<electionGuid>.json. Served as application/octet-stream (it is JSON). Fields federal.path, stateWide.path, senate.path, house.path, county.path, town.path, turnOut.path are relative paths with BACKSLASHES ('elections\\68d61e96-…-f-20261110182305.json'): replace '\\' with '/' and resolve against https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/. The suffix 20261110182305 is the publish time (yyyyMMddHHmmss, matches lastUpdatedDate '11/10/2026 06:23 PM'), so this file is the version pointer and must be re-read on every poll. rss.electionSummary / rss.electionResultData / rss.turnOutData give the stable RSS paths. The page showed 'NEXT UPDATE 04:52' counting down, i.e. roughly a 5-minute cycle.

feeds.what: elections list (148 entries: statewide elections and many town-level local ones)
feeds.notes: Array of {electionGuid, electionName, electionDate, electionDateWithName, isDefault, isStateWideElection, isGeneralElection, isSync, electionTypeCode, electionCategoryCode, isOfficial, electionYear, isHomeLinks, town}.

feeds.what: federal contests with town-by-town detail (1 office: Representative to Congress)
feeds.notes: Shape: d[] (party groups; one group with pid 0 in a general) -> o[] offices {oid, on (office name), vf (vote for), otc ('F' federal, 'S' statewide, 'GA' general assembly), cs[] (one summary row per town plus one total row), cd[] (flat per-town table)}. The total row is the cs entry with tid 0 and tn 'STATE WIDE' (or 'District Wide' in the senate/house files): {sc (votes cast), sv (overvotes), bv (blank votes), rc[] registered candidates {cid, cn, vc, isWriteIn, isWinner, pn, pco}, wc[] write-ins}. This URL changes with every publish.

feeds.what: statewide offices with town detail (6 offices)
State Senate (16 districts) with town detail
feeds.notes: Same shape plus district fields on each office: dc ('ADD 1'), dn ('ADDISON_'), isrep false.

feeds.what: State House (109 districts) with town detail
feeds.notes: Same shape; dc ('ADD RUT', 'ADD 1'), dn ('ADDISON RUTLAND', 'ADDISON-1'), isrep true.

feeds.what: town-by-town results for every contest (RSS), 6,886,908 bytes
feeds.notes: Over 5 MB (316,436 bytes gzipped), so only the first 1,048,576 bytes are kept; not needed for statewide totals.

election_id: electionGuid '68d61e96-1d28-4210-8c1d-8e90512ae105' ('2026 GENERAL ELECTION'; internal electionId 7100). It is the file name of the pointer (…/elections/<guid>.json), the prefix of every result file, and the folder of the RSS feeds (…/elections/rss/<guid>/).
discovery: GET https://static.electionresults.vermont.gov/elections/elections.json and take the entry with isStateWideElection true and the wanted electionDate (for the general also isGeneralElection true). Do not use isDefault alone: several entries are isDefault true (the 2026 general, the August primary, a town meeting). Beware the many town-level entries on the same date (isStateWideElection false, town set).
cors: * (access-control-allow-origin: * on elections.json, the pointer, the result JSON files and the RSS XML). A browser on openslate.us can read these directly.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 on everything (served from Azure blob storage behind F5 Distributed Cloud, 'server: volt-adc'); no challenge. Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried with curl. Headless Chrome with a desktop User-Agent also loaded the site.
updated_field: Pointer JSON lastUpdatedDate = '11/10/2026 06:23 PM' (US Eastern local time, no zone in the string; it equals the publish stamp 20261110182305 in the file names, and the page shows it as 'UNOFFICIAL 11/10/2026 06:23 PM'). HTTP Last-Modified on the pointer was Tue, 10 Nov 2026 23:23:51 GMT.
reporting_field: Vermont reports by TOWN, not precinct. Statewide, in the pointer: townsReporting = '247/247', townsReportingFormat = '247 OF 247', townReportingPercent = 100. Per district contest, on the total row of the senate/house files: townsReported = '25/25'. Per town row: distReported = '1/1'. (The statewide total row has distReported '0/0' and townsReported null: use the pointer for statewide offices.)

us_house: REPRESENTATIVE TO CONGRESS (at-large; Vermont has one seat)

choice_format: JSON: rc[] entries {"cid": 225757, "cn": "BECCA BALINT", "vc": 198758, "isWriteIn": false, "isWinner": true, "pn": "DEMOCRATIC", "pco": "007ABC"} - names ALL CAPS, party is the full name in pn (REPUBLICAN, DEMOCRATIC, PROGRESSIVE, INDEPENDENT, fusion as 'DEM/PROG', minor ones like 'PEACE AND JUSTICE'), pco is a hex colour, isWinner is filled in. Write-ins are a separate wc[] array ('OTHER WRITE-IN' plus each named write-in). XML: <Candidate><CandidateId>225757</CandidateId><Name>BECCA BALINT</Name><PartyName>DEMOCRATIC</PartyName><Votes>198758</Votes><CandidateType>Registered</CandidateType><Winner>True</Winner></Candidate>. No ballot measures in this election's files, so the yes/no form was not seen.
district_field: A separate field. JSON senate/house offices: dn (district name, e.g. 'ADDISON_', 'CHITTENDEN-CENTRAL_' for senate with a trailing underscore; 'ADDISON-1', 'ADDISON RUTLAND' for house) and dc (short code 'ADD 1'); the office name on is just 'STATE SENATOR' / 'STATE REPRESENTATIVE', so 16 + 109 offices share two names. XML: <OfficeDistrict>ADDISON_ SENATE</OfficeDistrict>. Districts are named, not numbered, and many elect 2 or 3 members (vf / <VoteFor>).
terms: none found on the results site (footer is only '© 2026 Copyright 128 State Street, Montpelier, Vermont 05633 sos.vermont.gov Version 1.0'). The site itself offers the RSS feeds under an 'RSS' tab. I did not search sos.vermont.gov for a general terms page.
